description: NaTm(SO₄)₂ crystallizes in the monoclinic P2₁/m space group. Na is bonded in a 7-coordinate geometry to seven O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.30-2.84 Å. Tm is bonded in a 7-coordinate geometry to seven O atoms. There are a spread of Tm-O bond distances ranging from 2.24-2.34 Å. There are two inequivalent S sites. In the first S site, S is bonded in a tetrahedral geometry to four O atoms. There are a spread of S-O bond distances ranging from 1.48-1.50 Å. In the second S site, S is bonded in a tetrahedral geometry to four O atoms. There are a spread of S-O bond distances ranging from 1.46-1.50 Å. There are six inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Na and one S atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Tm, and one S atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a 2-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Tm, and one S atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a bent 120 degrees geometry to one Tm and one S atom. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a 2-coordinate geometry to one Tm and one S atom. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Tm, and one S atom.
